title: Chapter 1 — Out of the Shadows
content:
For months, he had been a phantom in the peripheral vision of my life—a silhouette on the tree line, a hand guiding me out of danger when the syndicate’s enforcers raided the town.

Now he stood directly before me under the warehouse floodlights, dressed in black tactical gear with silver rings adorning his bruised knuckles. His amber eyes bore into mine with an intensity that burned the air between us.

"The game of hide and seek is over, Elena," Zane murmured, his voice sending a shiver down my spine. "They took you from my territory. That means they signed their own death warrant."

"I don’t need an executioner, Zane," I breathed, refusing to look away.

He stepped closer until his chest pressed against mine. "You don’t have an executioner, little mouse. You have me."

title: Scene 2 — Challenging the Elders and the Oath
content:
=== SCENE 2 — CHALLENGING THE ELDERS AND THE OATH ===

Setting: the Waterfront Warehouses of the Steel District. The atmosphere is charged with tension.

Elena: "We have walked under this cloud long enough. If we do not speak now, the truth will be buried beneath the soil of our ancestors!"

Zane: "Do you dare defy the council? Tradition was carved into stone long before your father learned to walk."

Elena: "Tradition that suffocates its own children is not wisdom—it is fear wearing a crown. Today, we choose life."

The onlookers murmur. The drumbeats slow, then erupt in a rhythmic cadence that reverberates across the hills.

Zane: "Then let heaven be the judge between your conviction and our law."

With a decisive movement, Elena turns toward the gathered assembly. The stage dims to an amber glow as destiny shifts into motion.
